items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) did not practice again Thursday after exiting Week 4 early; Rapoport previously called him week-to-week and not long-term. Unlikely to play Week 5 vs JAX in London.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs with hamstring; week-to-week designation
items.implication: Eagles backfield thins significantly; pass-heavy lean possible with depleted OL too
items.opportunity: Elevated carries/snaps for remaining RBs (Shipley lead, Pierce activated)

items.text: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) DNP Thursday for second straight day after missing Week 4; expected to miss Week 5 as well amid multiple WR injuries including Hollywood Brown and now Wicks limited.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs hamstring; already missed prior game
items.implication: Further depletes Eagles receiving corps behind A.J. Brown absence history; Hurts targets spread thin
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for remaining WRs/TEs like Goedert (limited knee) or depth options

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) did not practice Thursday (second straight DNP); Friday practice looms large for Sunday Night availability vs ATL. Coach notes he can play with little practice; Rapoport earlier said outside shot, possibly multi-week.
items.why: Ankle sprain (unconventional/outside); consecutive DNPs after Week 4 exit in boot/MRI
items.implication: Huntley likely start if out; Henry/Flowers/Andrews usage shifts in non-Lamar offense
items.opportunity: Monitor Friday; if OUT, pivot QBs and adjust Ravens skill shares

items.text: Steelers WR Michael Pittman Jr. aggravated foot injury (plantar fasciitis); coach McCarthy says will miss multiple weeks. Schefter confirmed re-injury and multi-week expectation.
items.why: Aggravated foot; multi-week absence confirmed by coach
items.implication: Steelers WR corps thins; more targets to remaining options in high pass-rate offense
items.opportunity: Upgraded routes/targets for DK Metcalf and other Steelers pass-catchers

items.text: Matthew Berry loves Nico Collins vs Titans this week, ranking him WR8; strong volume and red-zone usage against a defense allowing multiple double-digit WR scorers.
items.why: Matchup and target-hog profile; Titans soft vs WRs
items.opportunity: High target/route share expected to continue

items.text: Broncos HC Sean Payton taking over offensive play-calling (confirmed to reporters); process collaborative with OC but Payton has final say. ETR Man vs Machine discussed implications.
items.implication: Potential scheme/tempo/role shifts for Broncos skill players
items.opportunity: Watch for increased involvement or efficiency changes in Nix/Sutton/Harvey usage

items.text: Berry loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; workload plus Bengals WR injuries (Chase/Higgins) create more involvement potential against soft run defense.
items.why: Volume and matchup; WR injury boost
items.opportunity: Carries + possible expanded receiving with Chase/Higgins uncertain
items.conflict: Levitan notes Chase Brown underperforming xFP so far

items.text: Berry loves Michael Wilson vs DET as WR10; volume including red zone against Lions bottom-tier pass defense (every QB 21+ FP, high yards/TDs allowed).
items.why: Target volume + elite matchup vs Lions pass D
items.implication: Strong WR2/flex with upside in high-total DET-ARZ

items.text: Berry notes Kyren Williams 76% snaps and 47-14 touch edge over Corum past 2 games, 37% YFS on receptions, 69% routes last week; strong vs Bills who allow RB receiving TDs. Levitan adds Kyren (and Bijan) well above expected fantasy points on opportunities.
items.why: Dominant snap/touch share + receiving role; overperforming xFP
items.implication: Clear RB1 start with multi-faceted upside vs BUF
items.opportunity: High snap, route, and touch share locked in

items.text: ETR Week 5 waiver analysis highlights Saquon Barkley and Tank Bigsby injuries elevating Will Shipley to fantasy relevance; FAAB guidance and streaming options discussed. Man vs Machine covered Eagles depletion and Payton playcalling.
items.why: Primary backfield absences create clear lead-back opportunity
items.implication: Priority waiver add for RB depth; Shipley projected for majority rush share
items.opportunity: 50%+ rush offense potential in pass-leaning but volume-available spot vs JAX

items.text: Titans WR Carnell Tate limited Thursday with back injury ahead of vs HOU. Berry noted his recent high target/air-yards shares (season-high 43% targets, 73% air yards Week 4).
items.implication: Monitor status; high recent usage makes him relevant if active
items.opportunity: Prior 25%+ target shares and air-yards dominance

items.text: Bears RB D'Andre Swift limited Thursday (knee/hip); Kyle Monangai DNP second straight day (thumb/toe). Monitor depth chart and snap share.
items.why: Knee/hip for Swift; multi-day DNP for Monangai
items.implication: Possible reduced snaps or committee shift if lingering
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup elevation if either limited further

items.text: Berry loves Christian Watson vs CHI as WR15 on matchup and usage grounds.
items.opportunity: Route participation and deep threat role

items.text: Levitan highlights Bijan Robinson and Kyren Williams performing well above expected fantasy points on opportunities YTD; Ashton Jeanty and Chase Brown underperforming theirs. xFP data available for subscribers.
items.why: Actual FP vs expected on given opportunities
items.implication: Sustain/buy Bijan/Kyren efficiency; caution or buy-low on Jeanty/Chase Brown regression candidates
items.opportunity: Focus on opportunity quality over raw recent points
items.conflict: Berry loves Chase Brown weekly despite under xFP
